'''Nobel Energy''' (official name '''Nobel Energy Management LLC''', formerly '''Nobel Oil Services Ltd''') is a group of companies concentrated in the energy industry providing integrated engineering, construction, procurement and supply chain management, and drilling services.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=New Energy Joint Venture Formed In Caspian |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/new-energy-joint-venture-formed-in-caspian-2018-11-2-9/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref> Nobel Energy is a part of [[NEQSOL Holding]], an international group of companies, acting in energy, telecommunications, high-technology, and construction industries in the UK, the USA, [[Turkey]], [[Azerbaijan]], [[Ukraine]], Georgia, Kazakhstan, and the UAE.<ref>{{Cite web |last=MENAFN |title=Nobel Oil Services further strengthens its Board of Directors |url=https://menafn.com/1101943471/Nobel-Oil-Services-further-strengthens-its-Board-of-Directors |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=menafn.com |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Stanly |first=John |date=2021-09-23 |title=This Diversified Company Has Grown Through Innovations |url=https://www.entrepreneur.com/en-au/news-and-trends/this-diversified-company-has-grown-through-innovations/387198 |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=Entrepreneur |language=en |archive-date=2023-03-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230308135840/https://www.entrepreneur.com/en-au/news-and-trends/this-diversified-company-has-grown-through-innovations/387198 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== History ==

Nobel Energy was established in 2005<ref>{{cite journal|title=Azerbaijan 2020|journal=Foreign Affairs |date=Jan–Feb 2015|volume=94|page=8}}</ref> by Nasib Hasanov<ref>{{cite news |date=February 12, 2016 |title=Azerbaijani oil company acquires stake in UK field from Shell |agency=intellinews.com |url=http://www.intellinews.com/azerbaijani-oil-company-acquires-stake-in-uk-field-from-shell-90418/ |accessdate=30 December 2016}}</ref> an Azerbaijan-born businessman, as a technical service provider, offering services to the oil and gas industry in the [[Caspian region]]. These include wells’ work over, drilling, installation, construction, engineering, maintenance, repair, and operations services.<ref>{{Cite web |title=When You Think Of The Nobel Prize, Think Of Azerbaijan |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/when-you-think-of-the-nobel-prize-think-of-azerbaijan-2018-12-26-18/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":2" />

In 2007, Absheron Qazma (AQS), a subsidiary, established a joint venture with [[SOCAR]], SOCAR AQŞ, to deliver integrated drilling and well management services.<ref name=":5">{{Cite news |last=safaelsafa |date=2021-04-09 |title=SOCAR AQS Drills First Multilateral Well in South Caspian Basin - |language=en-US |url=https://azerbaijantoday.az/2021/04/09/socar-aqs-drills-first-multilateral-well-in-south-caspian-basin/ |access-date=2023-08-21}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite web |title=Nobel Oil Services Secures $100 Million Drilling Contract In Turkey |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/nobel-oil-services-secures-100-million-drilling-contract-in-turkey-2019-10-26-0/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2012, Nobel Energy established Global Energy Solutions (Glensol) and Prokon. Glensol’s key focus areas have been field operations and equipment maintenance services in Azerbaijan and [[Caspian Sea|regionally]]. Prokon has specialized in management of integrated infrastructure, industrial plants and facilities construction processes from design adaptation to [[procurement]] and [[construction]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2018-11-15 |title=Nobel Oil group of companies organizes training on turbomachinery technologies for first time in region |url=https://azertag.az/en/xeber/Nobel_Oil_group_of_companies_organizes_training_on_turbomachinery_technologies_for_first_time_in_region-1214911 |access-date=2023-08-21}}</ref>

In 2014, Nobel Energy reorganized its corporate structure to place its Azerbaijan-based businesses under a parent company headquartered in the UK and align its business processes with international standards.<ref name=":2" />

In 2014, the company developed its exploration and production activities and established Llamrei DMCC, focused on procurement and trading, logistics and expediting services, as well as warehouse and materials management.

In 2015, Nobel Energy acquired 50% of Denholm Oilfield Services Limited’s fabrication business in Azerbaijan. The same year, Glensol established a [[Joint venture|JV]] with Denholm Valvecare Limited to provide valve maintenance services.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-04-30 |title=SDL Nobel to render site installation services for BP assets in Azerbaijan |url=https://en.trend.az/business/energy/2895956.html |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=Trend.Az |language=en}}</ref>

In 2017, Nobel Energy and its subsidiaries received “Transparent Tax Partner” status granted by the [[Ministry of Taxes (Azerbaijan)|Ministry of Taxes]] for transparent financial performance.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |date=2018-02-27 |title=Nobel Oil Services establishes joint venture with GAMA Industry Inc |url=https://azertag.az/en/xeber/Nobel_Oil_Services_establishes_joint_venture_with_GAMA_Industry_Inc-1140682 |access-date=2023-08-21}}</ref>

In 2017, Glensol expanded its business to Kazakhstan.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-12-28 |title=Azerbaijan-based company Global Energy Solutions expands its business to Kazakhstan |url=https://azertag.az/en/xeber/Azerbaijan_based_company_Global_Energy_Solutions_expands_its_business_to_Kazakhstan-1124981 |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=azertag.az}}</ref>

In 2018, SOCAR AQS established a joint venture with KCA Deutag to provide well drilling and engineering services for the oil and gas industry.<ref>{{Cite web |title=$500 Million Deal Between BP and Turan Drilling & Engineering Is Expected To Develop Local Capacity In Azerbaijan's Energy Industry |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/500-million-deal-between-bp-and-turan-drilling-engineering-is-expected-to-develop-local-capacity-in-azerbaijans-energy-industry-2019-4-25-0/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref>

In 2018, Nobel Energy established a joint venture with Wood for the provision of engineering, procurement and construction management services.<ref name=":1" />

In 2019, Prokon and SOCAR AQS entered Turkish markets.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Azerbaijan’s SOCAR AQS opens office in Turkish Capital |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/economy/azerbaijan-s-socar-aqs-opens-office-in-turkish-capital/1619086 |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=www.aa.com.tr}}</ref>

In 2019, Nobel Energy received a ISO 37001:2016 certification (Anti-Bribery Management System) by LRQA, Lloyds register's Business Assurance and Inspection Services division. Nobel Energy renewed the certification in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UN Recognizes SOCAR AQS As Global Impact LEAD Company |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/un-recognizes-socar-aqs-as-global-impact-lead-company-2019-10-8-0/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref>

On 1 December 2021, the company announced a major rebrand, and set out a new strategy to transform the business from oil and gas services to an integrated energy production, development, and services company. The company name was changed from Nobel Oil Services to Nobel Energy.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2021-12-03 |title=Nobel Oil Announces Major Rebrand |url=https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/3521312.html |access-date=2023-08-01 |website=Trend.Az |language=en}}</ref>

== Operations ==
It specializes in project and construction management; fabrication and installation of [[structural steelwork]], upgrades of offshore facilities, pipework systems including high-pressure flow lines, vessels, tanks, and related packages; field operations and equipment maintenance; integrated drilling and well services; enhanced oil recovery services; and integrated supply chain management.<ref name=":1" />

=== Activities ===

* Integrated services – field operations, equipment maintenance (provided by Glensol), oil recovery services (provided by OGP)<ref name=":3" />
* Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC, provided by Prokon) – project and construction management, engineering, procurement and construction management (EPCM), and fabrication
* EPCM – engineering, procurement and construction management domain
* Integrated Procurement and Supply Chain Management (PSCM) – procurement, trading, logistics, expediting services, warehouse management, and materials management services for the energy industry
* Drilling services (provided by SOCAR AQS and Turan Drilling & Engineering) – integrated drilling and well, engineering, and well management across the Caspian Region, and Turkey

=== Subsidiaries and affiliates ===
Nobel Energy has five subsidiaries and affiliates:

* Audubon is a US-based company providing engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), construction management (EPCM), fabrication (EPFC), consulting, and technical services for the energy, chemicals, renewables, power and utility, and industrial markets.
* Glensol (Global Energy Solutions) is specialized in an oilfield operations and equipment maintenance company.<ref name=":3" /> 
* Prokon is specialized in the management of integrated infrastructure, industrial plants and facilities construction processes.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2022-04-01 |title=Prokon received a strategic contract for repair and modifying objects in Turkey |url=https://www.silkway.news/prokon-received-a-strategic-contract-65050/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=Silkway News}}</ref><ref name=":4" />
* Llamrei DMCC is specialized in integrated procurement and supply chain management (PSCM).
* OGP is a local company specialized in technologies, management and local expertise to the oil industry.<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |last=Thomas |first=Allister |date=2022-04-13 |title=EnerMech lands $3 million deals to support majors in Azerbaijan |url=https://www.energyvoice.com/oilandgas/europe/402782/enermech-azerbaijan-bp-totalenergies/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=Energy Voice |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Joint ventures ===

* SOCAR AQS is an integrated drilling and well services management company, jointly established between State Oil Company of Azerbaijan Republic (SOCAR), Nobel Energy Limited and Absheron Qazma LLC (AQS).<ref name=":5" /><ref name=":6" /> 
* Turan Drilling and Engineering is established by KCA Deuteg and SOCAR AQS.<ref name=":7">{{Cite web |title=Azerbaijani And US' Oil Field Service Companies Create Joint Venture in Caspian |url=https://caspiannews.com/news-detail/azerbaijani-and-us-oil-field-service-companies-create-joint-venture-in-caspian-2020-2-12-50/ |access-date=2023-08-21 |website=caspiannews.com |language=en}}</ref>
* Wood Group Azerbaijan is jointly established between Nobel Energy and Wood delivers integrated EPCM services in the Caspian region.<ref name=":1" />
* SDL Nobel is jointly established between Nobel Energy and Denholm Energy Services.
* EnerMech OGP is established by EnerMech and Oil and Gas ProServ (OGP), a Nobel Energy affiliate.<ref name=":8" />
* '''[[Umid Babek Operating Company]]''' (UBOC) is a joint operating company established in 2017 in partnership with [[SOCAR]] (80%) to explore and develop the Umid–Babek offshore hydrocarbon block, with Nobel Energy holding a 20% participating interest.<ref name="trend_uboc_nobel">{{cite news |title=Azerbaijan's SOCAR, Nobel Upstream launch new Caspian operating company |url=https://en.trend.az/business/energy/2755291.html |work=Trend News Agency |date=18 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170520000000/https://en.trend.az/business/energy/2755291.html |archive-date=20 May 2017 |url-status=live |access-date=24 May 2026}}</ref>

=== Clients ===
Among Nobel Energy's clients are SOCAR, BP, Siemens, Tüpraş, BOTAŞ, Wood, Karachaganak Petroleum Operating (KPO), Worley Parsons, Samsung Electronics, Saipem, Technip, and Biwater.<ref name=":4" />
